bond('E','G'); bond('G','I'); bond('G','K'); bond('G','H'); bond('H','Ocarbon',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('H','J'); bond('J','K'); bond('J','MeJ'); bond('K','L'); bond('L','I')
bond('K','Et1'); bond('Et1','Et2')

for n,i in ix.items():

m.AddConformer(conf)

 b=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(ix[center],ix[sub]); b.SetBondDir(dir)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,0,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
for n in ('I','K','J','G'):
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(ix[n]); print(n,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-')
# remove conformer, embed with stereochem
m.RemoveAllConformers()
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=129; params.maxIterations=2000
print('embed',AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params))
if m.GetNumConformers():

 # output temporary xyz
 conf=m.GetConformer()
 with open('/tmp/out.xyz','w') as f:

   p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()); f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.6f} {p.y:.6f} {p.z:.6f}\n')

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolTransforms
import numpy as np
rw=Chem.RWMol()
coords={}
def atom(name, elem):
    a=Chem.Atom(elem); idx=rw.AddAtom(a); coords[name]=idx; return idx
# heavy atoms
for n,e in [
('b3','C'),('b2','C'),('b1','C'),('b6','C'),('b5','C'),('b4','C'),
('A','C'),('B','C'),('N1','N'),('C','C'),('D','C'),('E','C'),('F','C'),('G','C'),('H','C'),('I','C'),('J','C'),('Oc','O'),('Ob','O'),('K','C'),('L','C'),('M','C'),('S','C'),('N2','N'),('MeN','C'),('O6','O'),('Me6','C'),('O5','O'),('Me5','C')]: atom(n,e)
# aromatic ring
for n in ['b3','b2','b1','b6','b5','b4']:
    rw.GetAtomWithIdx(coords[n]).SetIsAromatic(True)
for n1,n2 in [('b3','b2'),('b2','b1'),('b1','b6'),('b6','b5'),('b5','b4'),('b4','b3')]:
    rw.AddBond(coords[n1],coords[n2],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
# remaining edges
edges=[('b3','A'),('b4','N2'),('A','B'),('B','N1'),('A','H'),('A','S'),('N1','H'),('N1','C'),('C','D'),('D','E'),('E','F'),('F','G'),('G','H'),('G','I'),('G','K'),('H','Ob'),('I','J'),('J','Oc'),('J','Ob'),('J','Ocarbonyl'),('K','L'),('L','M'),('M','S'),('S','N2'),('N2','MeN'),('b6','O6'),('O6','Me6'),('b5','O5'),('O5','Me5')]
# add the carbonyl oxygen atom
# already not added, add now
atom('Ocarbonyl','O')
for a,b in edges:
    bt=Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if (a,b)==('L','M') or (a,b)==('J','Ocarbonyl') else Chem.BondType.SINGLE
    rw.AddBond(coords[a],coords[b],bt)
m=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
# image coords in pixels, y down; scale 0.01, z wedge endpoints
p={
'b3':(474,388,0),'b2':(371,326,0),'b1':(267,387,0),'b6':(267,510,0),'b5':(370,565,0),'b4':(474,510,0),
'A':(590,351,0),'B':(461,316,-80),'N1':(570,160,0),'C':(588,98,0),'D':(617,34,0),'E':(736,20,0),'F':(807,118,0),'G':(754,230,0),'H':(640,239,0),'I':(879,151,80),'J':(868,257,0),'Oc':(958,337,0),'Ob':(709,338,80),'K':(792,274,0),'L':(827,326,0),'M':(778,435,0),'S':(660,447,0),'N2':(590,545,0),'MeN':(615,635,-50),'O6':(220,535,0),'Me6':(170,560,0),'O5':(370,607,0),'Me5':(370,660,0),'Ocarbonyl':(953,320,0)}
# Correct O carbonyl image coordinate roughly right-lower.
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms()); conf.Set3D(True)
for name,i in coords.items():
    x,y,z=p[name]
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i,(x*.01,-y*.01,z*.01))
m.AddConformer(conf)
# Add explicit hydrogens with coordinates
m=Chem.AddHs(m, addCoords=True)
# assign H attached to S explicitly behind at drawn dashed wedge (pixel 704,517)
conf=m.GetConformer()
Sidx=coords['S']
for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(Sidx).GetNeighbors():
    if a.GetSymbol()=='H':
        # explicit wedge H from S towards lower-right, behind
        conf.SetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx(),(704*.01,-517*.01,-.8))
        break
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFrom3D(m, replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, force=True, cleanIt=True)
print('Stereo before:',[(n,m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetChiralTag(),m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetProp('_CIPCode') if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-') for n,i in coords.items()])
# Try embed conformer from chiral specifications
m.RemoveAllConformers()
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=127; params.maxIterations=3000; params.useSmallRingTorsions=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed',res,'atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
if res<0:
    params.randomSeed=42; params.useRandomCoords=True
    res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params); print('embed2',res)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,force=True,cleanIt=True)
print('Stereo embedded:',[(n,m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetChiralTag(),m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetProp('_CIPCode') if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-') for n,i in coords.items()])
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
if props:
    ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props,ignoreInterfragInteractions=False)
    print('energy initial',ff.CalcEnergy())
    ff.Minimize(maxIts=3000)
    print('energy final',ff.CalcEnergy())
else:
    print('no mmff')
# write xyz
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nGenerated from mol_0127.png\n')
    for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
        x,y,z=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {x: .8f} {y: .8f} {z: .8f}\n')
print('formula',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
